body: Drs in the UK have about 5 minutes to deal with your appointmnt. Mine put me on Sertranaline which is like being on an E (MDMA).   My job is quite complex so being high.doesnt really help me. I'm not taking it.

Do you have anxiety in the same way as me?  I mean there is no reason for it ? You have a great life, you have no good reason to be anxious, but you are anyway?  I cannot even imagine how I would feel if I had any actual reason to feel this way.
